## Privacy and security impact

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] `go -C native-host test ./...` passes when connector code changed
- [ ] I added or updated tests
- [ ] I tested the relevant flow in Chrome
- [ ] I did not add cookies, history, passwords, tokens, OAuth, or Discord page access
- [ ] I did not add a backend, telemetry, public listener, remote code, or `<all_urls>`
- [ ] Native Messaging changes keep the command allowlist and strict validation
- [ ] Documentation and privacy notices are current
